nd9174ba463.summary: The Association of Entrepreneurs' Voice proposed an urgent government package temporarily relieving fire-affected businesses in Omiš of tax, tourist, chamber and local levies.
nd9174ba463.why: Tourism and small business are major parts of Croatia's coastal economy, so fire damage to local firms has wider regional economic effects.

nb6fd9453d9.headline: Value of pending tax cases in the courts equals the sum of some of the largest public investments
nb6fd9453d9.summary: Tax cases over €1 million pending in administrative and tax courts total €23.2 billion, about 8% of Portugal's GDP. The sum is nearly three times the estimated cost of the new Lisbon airport.
nb6fd9453d9.why: Large pending tax disputes represent potential government revenue that is uncertain and can take years to resolve, which matters for fiscal planning and public debt assessments.

nab0e8778c2.headline: In Hungary, Paks NPP's operations are being saved: a sluice has opened on the Danube section Rácalmás-Shorokshar
nab0e8778c2.summary: A sluice opened on the Rácalmás–Shorokshar Danube section adds 20 cubic metres of water per second, which Prime Minister Péter Magyar says may raise Paks NPP's water level by two centimetres.
nab0e8778c2.why: Paks is Hungary's only nuclear power plant, and it depends on Danube water levels for its cooling.

n7ca3833034.summary: Siniša Mali said six parameters, including GDP growth, labour market, inflation and macroeconomic stability, are considered when setting the minimum wage, which will be decided at the next session.
n7ca3833034.why: The minimum wage sets a wage floor that affects labour costs, household incomes and inflation expectations.

ne1dce467e1.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Adrijana Mesarović said a state support package for small businesses is the most intensive ever, in both financial value and eligible applicants. The package was announced the previous day.
ne1dce467e1.why: State support for small businesses affects domestic demand, employment and lending conditions in the Serbian economy.

n72968db01f.summary: Economist Stoyan Panchev told Money.bg that slower price increases mean temporary disinflation. He said prices are still rising, only more slowly.
n72968db01f.why: Inflation measures the pace of price increases and drives central bank policy, bond yields and real returns for investors.

n3bd3d33f0c.headline: Funchal is the city where buying a home weighs most on family budgets
n3bd3d33f0c.summary: An Idealista analysis finds housing in Funchal absorbs 115% of household net income, the highest strain for buying a home in Portugal. In Madeira, rent takes 99% of household income.
n3bd3d33f0c.why: Housing affordability shapes household spending, mortgage demand and the outlook for the residential property market. Idealista is a Spanish property portal that publishes such analyses.

n154772c105.summary: Taiwan Mobile's wholly owned subsidiary Taixin Telecom launched a tender offer for Jingcheng Information, with acceptance running to 3:30 p.m. on 6 October. Commitments covering about 14.13% of shares have been obtained.
n154772c105.why: Taiwan Mobile is a major Taiwanese telecom operator, and tender offers are a common route for a buyer to gain control of a listed company.

n6e4964ee28.headline: Optima: Motor Oil heading toward historically high profitability
n6e4964ee28.summary: Optima sees adjusted EBITDA rising 104% in the second quarter, with Motor Oil heading toward historically high profitability. The figures were reported by Capital.gr.
n6e4964ee28.why: Motor Oil Hellas is a major Greek refiner and fuel distributor, so its earnings reflect refining margins and fuel demand in Greece and the wider region.

n2f06d4f2b9.headline: "Apartments are out of reach"… 'This place' where 5 trillion won in pooled money poured in, Gangbuk looks ominous
n2f06d4f2b9.summary: Capital is flowing into Seoul's multi-family and multiplex housing sales market, with transaction value in the second quarter nearing 5 trillion won. That is the highest level since 2021.
n2f06d4f2b9.why: Real estate transaction volumes and capital flows influence household finances, bank lending and the policy response in South Korea.

ne73ee3d5ba.headline: PIOJ cuts recovery timeline as economy contracts 2.9 per cent in June quarter
ne73ee3d5ba.summary: Jamaica's economy shrank 2.9% in the April to June quarter, and the Planning Institute shortened its recovery timeline to two years from three.
ne73ee3d5ba.why: Jamaica's economy depends heavily on tourism and remittances, so GDP swings shape fiscal planning, debt sustainability and investor sentiment.

n9d9df777ff.headline: Ethiopia: 50,600 Ethiopians Left Country in First Quarter of 2026 Amid Economic Hardship, Migrant Exploitation
n9d9df777ff.summary: An estimated 50,600 people left Ethiopia through the Eastern Route in the first quarter of 2026, according to an IOM report. Migrants faced economic hardship and exploitation by smugglers.
n9d9df777ff.why: Migration flows reflect economic conditions and labour demand, and they shape remittance income for origin countries such as Ethiopia.

nc39f94a875.headline: Government moves to fast-track Mau Summit-Eldoret-Malaba road project
nc39f94a875.summary: The Kenyan government is moving to fast-track the Mau Summit-Eldoret-Malaba road project, upgrading a key Northern Corridor link for trade with Uganda and East Africa.
nc39f94a875.why: The Northern Corridor is a major trade route linking the port of Mombasa to Uganda and landlocked East African markets, so road upgrades affect freight costs.

na976ad5deb.headline: Battered by war, Iran’s rulers wary of more economic pain and unrest if US tightens pressure
na976ad5deb.summary: Iran's leaders fear that a threat of more US economic punishment could deepen hardship and reignite unrest, according to Reuters. US President Trump vowed to hit Iran hard economically.
na976ad5deb.why: Sanctions and economic pressure on Iran affect global oil supply, regional stability and investor risk appetite in the Middle East.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

sources.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012

n24bdd97b94.headline: Oil Rally Boosted Nigeria's Earnings In H1 – Afreximbank
n24bdd97b94.summary: Nigeria was among the African economies that benefited most from a strong rally in global oil prices in the first half of 2026, according to Afreximbank. The bank is headquartered in Cairo.
n24bdd97b94.why: Nigeria is a major oil exporter, so higher crude prices raise government revenue and foreign-exchange earnings.

n64b8d7f58c.headline: Warning: Maize price could rocket to K1,270 per kg by year end | Nyasa Times
n64b8d7f58c.summary: New figures show the price of maize, Malawi's staple food, has surged sharply. A warning says the price could reach K1,270 per kg by year end.
n64b8d7f58c.why: Maize is a staple grain whose price drives food inflation and household budgets across southern Africa.

source.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

sources.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

na32496092c.headline: Rwanda: Five Areas Where Budget Oversight Falls Short
na32496092c.summary: Rwanda has opened up its budget process, but the latest Open Budget Survey shows uneven progress, low public participation and weaker parliamentary oversight than in 2017.
na32496092c.why: Budget transparency and oversight affect investor confidence in public finances and governance in emerging markets.

n073556fe5d.headline: ‘Investors will be happy’: Zambia’s pro-business president wins second term
n073556fe5d.summary: Hakainde Hichilema was declared the winner of Zambia's elections, an outcome investors will welcome as he builds on economic successes in Africa's second-biggest copper producer. The result extends his rule.
n073556fe5d.why: Zambia is Africa's second-largest copper producer, so its political stability and mining policy matter to global copper supply. Investor confidence in its government affects sovereign debt and mining investment.

n91189173a1.headline: Licence, logo or lookalike? Cyprus crypto changes under MiCA
n91189173a1.summary: Crypto users in Cyprus are urged to check which company holds their assets after the EU's MiCA transition forced unauthorised providers to withdraw, while fraudsters exploit the change.
n91189173a1.why: MiCA is the EU's crypto-asset regulation, which requires licensed providers and sets rules for crypto firms operating across member states.

ncfee5f6158.headline: No US-Iran Talks Planned, Hormuz Remains Closed
ncfee5f6158.summary: US President Donald Trump said no talks with Iran were taking place or scheduled, while insisting the Strait of Hormuz was open. The statement came amid the ongoing conflict.
ncfee5f6158.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint through which a large share of global seaborne oil passes. Diplomatic developments there directly affect crude supply and prices.
ncfee5f6158.why_moved: With no talks planned and the strait described as closed, uncertainty over Gulf oil flows persists.

ne0bd164cac.headline: Saudis Offer to Sell Oil Near Oman, a Possible Sign They’re Sailing Dark Through Hormuz
ne0bd164cac.summary: Saudi Arabia is offering to sell oil from off the coast of Oman, a sign it may follow the UAE in shuttling more barrels through the Strait of Hormuz.
ne0bd164cac.why: Saudi Arabia is the largest crude exporter in OPEC, so its export routing directly affects global oil supply.

n3421db65bb.headline: Blood plasma giant's share price revives on growth path
n3421db65bb.summary: Australian healthcare giant CSL, which reported its first annual loss as a listed group, has staged a share price recovery. The company is now on a growth path.
n3421db65bb.why: CSL is a major global producer of plasma-derived therapies, and its earnings and share price are watched as a bellwether for the healthcare sector in Australia.

n8bdd86f431.headline: US stocks open lower as Iran stalemate lifts oil, yields
n8bdd86f431.summary: Wall Street's main indexes opened lower as fading prospects for a US-Iran peace deal kept oil prices high and government bond yields near multi-year highs.
n8bdd86f431.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance, while Treasury yields influence borrowing costs across the economy.
n8bdd86f431.why_moved: Diminishing prospects for a US-Iran peace deal kept oil prices elevated and bond yields high, weighing on equity futures at the open.

n9dcec6f5b0.headline: Equity overweight surges to highest level since 2021 in BofA survey
n9dcec6f5b0.summary: Investors continued to add to positions in tech stocks, emerging markets and North America, according to the BofA survey. Cash holdings hit a new low.
n9dcec6f5b0.why: Bank of America's monthly fund manager survey tracks professional investor positioning, which indicates how much capital is already committed to equities.

nacf07ab1cd.headline: Retirement savings to be 'decimated' under early access
nacf07ab1cd.summary: The Australian treasurer has cautioned against a push for Australians to dip into their superannuation early to deal with cost pressures. The article says retirement savings would be decimated under early access.
nacf07ab1cd.why: Superannuation is Australia's compulsory retirement savings system, and early-access proposals affect retirement balances and fund flows.

nee282dc45d.headline: Seafarer Killed in Latest Strait of Hormuz Attack on Commercial Shipping
nee282dc45d.summary: Two bulk carriers were struck by projectiles in separate attacks while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The attacks caused two crew casualties, including one seafarer killed aboard a Liberia-flagged vessel.
nee282dc45d.why: Attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz raise insurance premiums and freight rates, and can disrupt global bulk commodity flows.
nee282dc45d.why_moved: Projectile attacks on bulk carriers in the Strait of Hormuz raise shipping and insurance risk.

n13cac82672.headline: Ondas To Acquire Aran Defense For $33 Mln; Stock Down In Pre-Market
n13cac82672.summary: Ondas Inc. has agreed to acquire Aran Defense Ltd., the defense-focused division of Israeli engineering and manufacturing company Aran Ltd. Ondas makes autonomous drone and defense technology.
n13cac82672.why: Ondas is a US-listed provider of drone and defense technology, and defense consolidation is a theme for technology investors. The deal adds an Israeli defense division to its portfolio.

n1957615491.headline: ‘Escape the debt’: Activewear brand shuts down
n1957615491.summary: A popular Australian activewear brand announced it is shutting down, three months after a viral gym-shaming video sparked online backlash.
n1957615491.why: Small consumer brands' closures reflect retail demand and cost pressures in the apparel sector.

na7ec8a9af5.headline: Nike stock hits 12-year low as JPMorgan downgrades shares
na7ec8a9af5.summary: JPMorgan cut Nike to Underweight on Monday after a disappointing sales report from rival On Holding added pressure to the athletic footwear sector. Nike stock hit a 12-year low.
na7ec8a9af5.why: Nike is a global athletic footwear and apparel company, and its sales trends are a key read on consumer discretionary demand.
na7ec8a9af5.why_moved: A JPMorgan downgrade to Underweight and a disappointing sales report from On Holding added pressure on the stock, per the input.

n5f2c7b6ec8.headline: Middle East conflict cuts QIC’s profit
n5f2c7b6ec8.summary: Qatar Insurance Company's first-half net profit declined 5% year on year to QAR 365 million ($100 million). The drop reflects claims and reserve increases tied to the Middle East conflict.
n5f2c7b6ec8.why: Qatar Insurance is one of Qatar's largest insurers, and its results reflect regional conflict-related claims exposure.

nb332741eb6.headline: Matador Resources, Oceaneering, Northern Oil and Gas, and Talos Energy Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know
nb332741eb6.summary: Several energy stocks jumped in the afternoon session after Iran ruled out extending a 60-day memorandum of understanding with the United States. The four named companies were among the gainers.
nb332741eb6.why: Matador Resources and Northern Oil and Gas are US oil and gas producers, so their shares track crude price expectations closely.
nb332741eb6.why_moved: Iran ruled out extending the 60-day memorandum of understanding with the United States, which raised concerns about Strait of Hormuz supply and lifted energy shares.

n9bfecb83c5.headline: Vacancies slip again as private sector pay growth falls to near six-year low
n9bfecb83c5.summary: UK job vacancies slipped again and private sector pay growth fell to near a six-year low. The ONS said small firms may be holding back recruitment due to higher labour costs and other expenses.
n9bfecb83c5.why: Labour market slack and wage growth shape Bank of England rate decisions and UK consumer spending, which affect gilts, sterling and UK equities.

n5f9f3addaf.headline: UN Secretary-General calls for resumption of Iran-US talks
n5f9f3addaf.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called on Iran and the US to resume negotiations toward a settlement of the conflict, his spokesman said.
n5f9f3addaf.why: Diplomatic progress between Iran and the US influences oil supply risk and regional stability.

n5dd3435b89.headline: Moody's: 'Semiconductor Boom to Last Until Mid-Next Year'... Raises Korea's Growth Forecast to 3.5%
n5dd3435b89.summary: Moody's raised its 2025 growth forecast for South Korea to 3.5%, up from 2.5% in May and 1.8% in February. It expects the semiconductor boom to last until at least mid-next year.
n5dd3435b89.why: Moody's is one of the three major credit rating agencies, and its growth outlooks inform views on sovereign credit and the economy.

n5dd3435b89.original_headline: 무디스 “반도체 호황 내년 중반까지”⋯ 韓성장률 3.5%로 상향

nb846f37cbb.headline: Shareholder approval sought for share issuance in bank deal
nb846f37cbb.summary: Butterfield Bank is seeking shareholder approval to issue almost 12 million new shares. The shares are part of an almost $1.8 billion purchase of a major Caribbean bank announced in May.
nb846f37cbb.why: Butterfield is a Bermuda-based bank with Caribbean operations, and share issuance for an acquisition dilutes existing holders while expanding its footprint.

n3807147e3e.headline: Top Russian economist ousted after warning of growing costs of Ukraine war
n3807147e3e.summary: Andrey Klepach, the top economist at state development bank VEB, has been ousted after warning that Russia was lagging behind rivals. He had also warned of the growing costs of the Ukraine war.
n3807147e3e.why: VEB is Russia's state development bank, and its economic assessments reflect the fiscal strain of sanctions and war spending.

n56fb96ab54.headline: Romania Prepares for a new peak in electricity consumption. Bușoi: Import prices exceed €200 during peak hours
n56fb96ab54.summary: Romania faces no risk to electricity supply security, but a heatwave will push consumption above 7,000 MW and raise imports. Import prices exceed €200 during peak hours, according to Cristian Bușoi.
n56fb96ab54.why: Electricity import prices during peak demand affect household bills and industrial costs. Romania relies on imports when domestic generation is constrained.

nc7ecc2e32c.headline: Government relies on ‘chainsaw’ measures to maintain fiscal surplus
nc7ecc2e32c.summary: Argentina's government is relying on spending cuts to maintain its fiscal surplus. July cuts were applied even in sectors with mandatory spending, including national highway maintenance.
nc7ecc2e32c.why: Fiscal surpluses reduce government borrowing needs, which is closely watched by investors in Argentine sovereign debt and the peso.

n096a698ec7.headline: Trump says no talks are taking place with Iran and none are scheduled
n096a698ec7.summary: US President Donald Trump said no talks are taking place with Iran and none are scheduled. He said the Strait of Hormuz remains open, while Iran said the route stays closed until Washington meets interim deal terms.
n096a698ec7.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil trade, so disruption there feeds directly into crude prices and global energy markets.
n096a698ec7.why_moved: Trump said no talks are under way and Iran said the Strait of Hormuz stays closed until US terms are met, keeping shipping through the route in doubt.

nffe6eb9bbd.headline: A Top Russian Economist Warned Of an Impending Social Crisis. He Was Fired.
nffe6eb9bbd.summary: Economist Andrei Klepach warned Russia cannot win a prolonged war of attrition after more than four years of conflict. He was subsequently fired.
nffe6eb9bbd.why: Russia's wartime economy, labour market and public finances are central to assessing sanctions impact and the country's economic outlook.

n4d5b6e4b47.headline: Tempsens Instruments to Launch ₹650-Crore IPO on August 20, Price Band Set at ₹285–₹300 per Share
n4d5b6e4b47.summary: Tempsens Instruments will launch its Rs 650-crore IPO on August 20, with a price band of Rs 285-300 per share. Proceeds are aimed at capex, debt repayment and corporate purposes.
n4d5b6e4b47.why: IPOs show how companies raise public capital and signal investor appetite for listings in a given market.

n6f8c14a8d6.headline: BHP chief labels state's royalty regime unsustainable
n6f8c14a8d6.summary: BHP's chief executive said a sliding-scale royalty regime introduced by an Australian state four years ago makes investing there unsustainable. The state is not named in the input.
n6f8c14a8d6.why: BHP is one of the world's largest mining companies, and royalty regimes directly affect the returns on mining investment in Australia.

n290903fdfa.headline: Rupee falls 7 paise to close at 95.68 against US dollar
n290903fdfa.summary: The rupee fell 7 paise to 95.68 against the dollar. The decline was attributed to rising crude prices and geopolitical tensions.
n290903fdfa.why: The Indian rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors in Indian assets.

n90b2c2bae9.headline: Govt Plans Major FDI Rule Changes: CCEA Approval Limit May Rise To ₹15,000 Crore
n90b2c2bae9.summary: The government is considering raising the FDI approval threshold for the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs from Rs 5,000 crore to Rs 15,000 crore. It is also examining relaxed rules for downstream foreign investments.
n90b2c2bae9.why: Foreign direct investment rules determine how easily overseas capital can enter Indian businesses, affecting deal flow and sector valuations.

nf36fe44ed3.headline: Gold Pulls Back Amid Middle East Tensions and Fed Rate Uncertainty
nf36fe44ed3.summary: Gold pulled back after failing again to move above a temporary ceiling of $4,435, as US-Iran tensions over the Strait of Hormuz remain elevated and Fed rate expectations stay uncertain.
nf36fe44ed3.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset whose price tends to respond to geopolitical risk and expectations for US interest rates.

ne1c48d6c72.headline: RBI gives $50 billion boost: How FCNR(B) deposits are strengthening India’s forex position - BusinessToday
ne1c48d6c72.summary: SBI Research said FCNR(B) deposits stood at $52.3 billion as of August 13, and total mobilisation including overseas borrowings and external commercial borrowings reached $56.8 billion.
ne1c48d6c72.why: FCNR(B) deposits are foreign currency accounts held by non-resident Indians in Indian banks, and inflows of them help India build its foreign exchange reserves.

n0c70ad60f4.headline: AUD/CAD: Two Hawkish Central Banks, One Triangle Left to Break
n0c70ad60f4.summary: RBA Assistant Governor Christopher Kent reaffirmed that tighter policy is working as intended, giving the Australian dollar hawkish backing going into the week.
n0c70ad60f4.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, and its tone on tightening influences the Australian dollar and short-term yields.

n8b3375b2af.headline: S&P 500 futures fall as U.S.-Iran truce expires, yields spike
n8b3375b2af.summary: S&P 500 futures fell as the US-Iran truce expired, while the 30-year Treasury yield reached its highest level since 2007. Oil climbed and chip stocks dragged Nasdaq futures lower.
n8b3375b2af.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies, and the 30-year Treasury yield sets long-term borrowing costs across the economy.

impacts.why: The index futures fell directly on the reported move after the truce expiry.

n8b3375b2af.why_moved: The US-Iran truce expired, oil climbed, and chip stocks weighed on Nasdaq futures, while the 30-year yield rose to its highest level since 2007.

n31cf31ac7a.headline: Vector boosts profit by 55%, but contributions on decline
n31cf31ac7a.summary: Energy distributor Vector raised net profit after tax by 55% to $240.2 million on $1.2 billion revenue for the 12 months to June. Gross capital expenditure was $544 million.
n31cf31ac7a.why: Vector is a New Zealand energy distribution company operating electricity and gas networks.

sources.name: NBR | Business news & analysis | Independent, ad-free reporting

n35a24d9ca3.headline: Ringgit extends gains to close higher vs major, regional currencies
n35a24d9ca3.summary: The ringgit extended its gains to close higher against major and regional currencies on Tuesday. Declining expectations of a US Federal Reserve rate hike in September weighed on the greenback.
n35a24d9ca3.why: The ringgit's value affects Malaysian import costs, foreign investment returns and the competitiveness of its exports.

nb870cb4e8a.headline: Iran says Hormuz will remain closed until the US fulfils its commitment under the memorandum
nb870cb4e8a.summary: Iran said it will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz until the United States fulfils its commitments under a memorandum of understanding signed by both sides. The closure continues.
nb870cb4e8a.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil chokepoints, so its closure can tighten crude supply and raise freight costs.
nb870cb4e8a.why_moved: Iran will keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until the US meets its memorandum commitments. The closure restricts seaborne oil flows through a key chokepoint.

n920f33eb65.headline: Trump continues to stress 'Iran cannot have a nuclear weapon' despite unclear path to end war
n920f33eb65.summary: There is no timetable to end the Iran war after a 60-day goal to reach an agreement expired on Monday, with negotiations stalled as the conflict nears its sixth month.
n920f33eb65.why: The conflict affects oil supply risk, shipping through the Gulf and broader risk sentiment across global markets.
n920f33eb65.why_moved: The 60-day deadline for an agreement lapsed with talks stalled and no timetable to end the war, keeping geopolitical and oil supply risk high.

n0b7b77f478.headline: Rupee Declines 7 Paise To Close At 95.68 Against US Dollar, Weighed Down By High Crude Prices & West Asia Tensions
n0b7b77f478.summary: The rupee closed 7 paise lower at 95.68 against the US dollar. Pressure came from high crude prices, West Asia tensions, foreign institutional investor selling and broader dollar strength.
n0b7b77f478.why: The rupee's level affects the cost of India's crude and other imports, and foreign portfolio flows are an important source of capital for Indian markets.

n903ff24203.headline: Sensex plunges 493 points, Nifty falls 133 points amid global tensions
n903ff24203.summary: The Sensex and Nifty extended losses amid heightened geopolitical tensions and weakness in key sectors. The Sensex fell 493 points and the Nifty 133 points.
n903ff24203.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's main benchmark indices, reflecting large domestic and foreign-investor sentiment.
n903ff24203.why_moved: Indian benchmarks extended losses amid heightened geopolitical tensions and weakness in key sectors.

n6f31b29fae.headline: Hormuz Crisis Doubles Oil Giants’ Profits To $90bn — Report
n6f31b29fae.summary: A new report says the near-complete closure of the Strait of Hormuz has sharply lifted oil companies' profits, roughly doubling them to $90bn. Supply disruption drove the increase.
n6f31b29fae.why: Oil majors' earnings depend on crude prices and supply, so disruptions in key shipping chokepoints like Hormuz feed directly into their results.

n6f51b1bac1.headline: Torrent Gas Plans ₹4,000 Crore IPO Draft Filing This Week
n6f51b1bac1.summary: Torrent Gas is likely to file updated draft papers for an IPO worth up to Rs 4,000 crore as early as this week, according to sources. The company supplies piped and compressed natural gas across India.

n8e1f7e38d6.why_moved: Japanese stocks closed with a sharp plunge while Japanese government bonds rallied to a three-decade high, and most other Asian exchanges weakened.

n7ad15d7a85.headline: Samsung-Hynix Leveraged ETF Trading Evaporates 89%… Will the '2x Multiple' Be Adjusted?
n7ad15d7a85.summary: Trading value of single-stock leveraged products offering up to 2x exposure to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell about 90% after a higher basic deposit requirement. Lawmakers suggested the leverage multiple could be adjusted.
n7ad15d7a85.why: Leveraged single-stock products amplify daily price moves and are regulated through margin and deposit rules in Korea. Changes to these rules affect trading volumes and market volatility.

ndd2a101785.headline: Delivery breaks records with 17 million orders a month
ndd2a101785.summary: At least 400 food orders are placed every minute in Greece, with delivery turnover reaching billion-scale. Dine-in businesses are reportedly losing turnover.
ndd2a101785.why: Food delivery platforms are large consumer-facing businesses whose growth can shift sales away from traditional restaurants.
